name: feature-carousel
blurb: Multi-step feature showcase with animated image transitions and step navigation.
description: Animated carousel showcasing 4 feature steps with varying layouts. Each step has custom image positioning and animations (slide-in, fade-in, scale). Includes auto-play with 3s interval and clickable step indicators.
use_when: Showcasing product features or workflow steps with rich animated transitions.
avoid_when: Content that doesn't fit 4 discrete steps; requires image assets for all steps.
a11y: Step indicators are clickable buttons with visual state indicators. No keyboard arrow navigation.
